newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DE BILDE SCORES TWICE AS PSV GO TOP AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DE BILDE SCORES TWICE AS PSV GO TOP AGAIN.

text.p: Belgian striker Gille de Bilde scored twice to help PSV Eindhoven regain top spot in the Dutch first division when they beat Sparta Rotterdam 3-1 on Wednesday.
The Eindhoven side lost first place on Sunday when Feyenoord took the lead after beating NAC Breda 2-0.
With four matches to go, PSV have 68 points while Feyenoord trail by two points.
In the 24th minute Philip Cocu put PSV 1-0 up with a header from a Wim Jonk corner.
Dennis de Nooyer equalised 10 minutes later when he cunningly curled the ball under Jan-Willem van Ede, who stood in for injured goalkeeper Ronald Waterreus.
In the 58th minute de Bilde beat the Sparta defence to make the score 2-1, and two minutes before time he scored his second.
Ajax Amsterdam dropped another two points in their bid to secure a place in the UEFA Cup next season after drawing 1-1 away to Groningen.
Ajax had to field a below-strength attack, with Marc Overmars and Patrick Kluivert out injured and Tijjani Babangida in Nigeria for family business.

The Amsterdam side lost 2-1 against Sparta on Sunday and went 1-0 behind on Wednesday when Groningen scored from the penalty spot in the 70th minute after skipper Danny Blind fouled Joop Gall in the box.
Six minutes later, striker Dennis Schulp, replacing Ronald de Boer who was stretchered off with a back injury, prevented Ajax from a bigger humiliation when he levelled from a Martijn Reuser cross.
The Amsterdammers are fourth with 52 points.
